title: LEDs work either way round
belief: An LED is just a tiny bulb. It lights up whichever way round I put it in.
sources: Peppler, K. & Glosson, D. (2013). Stitching circuits: Learning about circuitry through e-textile materials. Journal of Science Education and Technology. https://doi.org/10.1007/s10956-012-9428-2
